recentWins: Had a fantastic Blackpool family weekend and came home feeling that life is being lived, not just managed.
Adapted when the Blackpool Tower trip was cancelled by the wind, rescheduled it and enjoyed the rest of the day anyway.
Made the extra journey to see Uncle Alfie on the way home; he was so happy and the visit mattered.
Chapter 15 of The Secret of Secrets completed.
Amazon returns taken back and completed.
About five weeks into the journey, a new rhythm is starting to form.

dailyLog.personal: Finished the Blackpool weekend with a detour to see Uncle Alfie in Abergele for roast lunch before heading home.
dailyLog.avoidance: It would have been easy to skip the extra journey after a busy weekend.
dailyLog.response: Made the diversion because seeing him mattered, and he was really happy.

dailyLog.personal: Blackpool Tower, 4D experience, glass floor, Fleetwood Market, La Fontana and Funny Girls.
dailyLog.response: Went back for the Tower after Friday's cancellation and made the final night special.

dailyLog.personal: Tower Ballroom afternoon tea, fish and chips, arcades and the Blackpool Illuminations switch-on with fireworks.
dailyLog.avoidance: Tower trip cancelled because of strong wind.
dailyLog.response: Rescheduled it rather than letting the cancellation spoil the day.

dailyLog.personal: Travelled to Blackpool with Jason, Eve, Mum and Dad; settled into a brilliant Airbnb and had dinner at the Juicy Lobster.
dailyLog.response: Got everyone there, accepted the small compromises and enjoyed the start of the trip.

dailyLog.personal: Created and shared an illustrated Blackpool trip plan for Mum and Dad ahead of the family holiday.
dailyLog.avoidance: None. This was choosing to put effort into family time and anticipation.
dailyLog.response: Made the trip feel special before it starts instead of treating it as just another diary event.

dailyLog.personal: In the office all day with lots of meetings; possible Apple launch later.
dailyLog.work: Busy office day with several meetings and a possible Apple launch.
dailyLog.response: Getting on with the day and seeing what it brings.

dailyLog.personal: Chapter 15 in progress; Amazon returns taken back; looking forward to Blackpool with Mum & Dad next week; Dante and Amara chosen and coming home on 24 October
dailyLog.response: Kept reading moving, closed the Amazon return task and noticed how much there is to look forward to

journey.title: A weekend that felt like living again
journey.text: Blackpool with Jason, Eve, Mum and Dad became much more than a trip in the diary. We travelled together, laughed, ate well, watched the Illuminations and fireworks, had afternoon tea in the Tower Ballroom, finally made it up Blackpool Tower after the wind cancellation, went to Funny Girls and finished with a family detour to Uncle Alfie on the way home. The strongest thing about the weekend was how much enjoyment, connection and ordinary life there was in it. I came home thinking simply: what a great weekend.

lookingForward.title: Dante & Amara come home
lookingForward.detail: 24 October. Our new kittens are growing fast. We visit them every two weeks and Christine sends regular updates in between.
